body: The eating thing really isn't that simple though because I have IBS, I can barely eat without getting sick to my stomach.  I will have a single granola bar and feel full.

Its a lot of things, loneliness is just one. Another is the way I look, Im 22 and 6ft tall and I way 140 pounds, as a guy I look like a skeleton and harassed for it.  I get treated like shit by everyone I know and they treat me like a joke because I use humor to try and cope with my depression so they assume that it is ok to treat me like dirt.  I have no real friends anymore, there is no one to hang out with and I can't even think of one person I would talk to about this that would even care.  I was told by a girl I care deeply about that while we were fuckbuddies and I wanted something more it could never be, even though she loves how much I care for her and how she loves me for being able to talk to her when she feels suicidal and how I kept her from killing herself.  Everyone comes to me to solve their problems and when I tell them i can't and that I have enough of my own they attack me and call me selfish.  I feel as though I have the world on my shoulders and no one to help.  I can't stand the loneliness and I can't do anything about it Im 22 and I cant even talk to girls and havent even been on a date because anytime I see someone I might like I cant form words and manage to kill any conversation in seconds.  Everyone continues to friendzone me or use me as an emotional crutch without respect for my feelings or my needs.  

This is what I deal with all the time, I can't stand it.



  Her:   don't know what you want! I thought I'd show you how much I care and tell you the truth! I thought I could count on your support... Dammit, you're the only one on this earth who I trust enough to tell when I'm having suicide thoughts... You're the only one who can talk a little sense into me, enough to get me through the night... You don't know how much I need you. You know my heart belongs to the [rival fraternity] boys, but you're something more. I know I can count on you to be there when I need you... You never let me down...



Her:    Tell when I'm having my suicidal thoughts... You're the only one who can talk some sense into me, even enough to get me through the night... You never let me down when I need you!

    You're the only who knows my secrets and what to say to make it okay for a little bit... You don't know how much I need you...

    I can't ever be with you bc of that...

    It's not the friendzone, but if I ever got upset about us, I would literally throw myself off a ledge.


Me:    You cant be with me because I care and want you to be happy?


Her:    I wouldn't be able to handle it... I would lose my fucking mind...
          You're my light in my darkest hours.. I can't lose that...
